decision.reason: Both registered and legacy quality gates reject 2D despite lower coherent and waveform error. All loss variants also regress mean ESTOI in both-language decoded validation.

limitations: VCTK acceptance uses new audio from the same 12 held-out speakers already inspected in the oracle study.
Swedish sentence groups are disjoint, but speaker separation is unknown and speech is native16kHz.
Training targets are uninterrupted decoded codec audio; intelligibility uses original clean speech.
MR-STFT sequences begin with the native overlap, without a full preceding received frame.
No listening study, Opus comparison or universal causal-capacity ceiling is established.
